sections.text: The standard recommendation is 3-6 months of essential living expenses. If you have stable employment, dual income, and strong job security, 3 months may be enough. If you are self-employed, work on commission, or have a single income, aim for 6-12 months. Essential expenses include housing, food, utilities, insurance, transportation, and minimum debt payments.
Use our savings calculator to determine how much to save each month to reach your emergency fund target by a specific date.

sections.heading: Plan Your Emergency Savings
sections.body: Use our savings calculator to set a monthly savings target for your emergency fund.
